title: Seronera: Big Cats in the Central Serengeti
excerpt: Seronera, in the heart of the Serengeti, is known for big cats and resident wildlife all year round. What to expect there.
body:
Seronera is the central area of the Serengeti, around the Seronera River valley. If you only have time for one area, this is often the best choice.

## Why Seronera works

- **Resident wildlife.** Many animals stay here all year, regardless of the migration.
- **Water.** The Seronera River keeps flowing in the dry season, attracting wildlife.
- **Big cats.** Seronera has one of the highest densities of lions in Africa, and leopards are often seen in the sausage trees and acacias along the river.
- **Kopjes.** Granite outcrops where lions rest and cheetahs look out over the plains.

## Game drives

The road network is good, so you can cover a lot of ground. The downside: in high season, popular sightings can attract many vehicles. A good guide knows quieter spots and timing.

## Visitor centre

The Serengeti visitor centre at Seronera has an informative exhibition and a short walking trail with hyraxes and lizards.

## Balloon safaris

Several balloon flights take off from the Seronera area. See [hot air balloon safari](/blog/serengeti-balloon-safari/).

## Combine

Seronera combines well with the south (December–March) or the north (July–October). See [the regions explained](/blog/serengeti-regions-explained/).
